title: DNA Extraction from Sputum
author: Laszlo Irinyi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6enhbde

steps.title: Prepare sputum and freeze‑grind
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 600 µL of each sputum sample into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube (max 600 µL per tube). Work under full PPE, leave the tube lid open, and place a small plastic pestle inside. Fill a 100 mL cup with liquid nitrogen, then immerse the tube (pestle inside) up to the lid opening for 3 seconds. Remove the tube and use the pestle to grind the sputum for 60 seconds, turning continuously. Repeat the immersion‑grind cycle five times for each tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer sputum (≤600 µL) to 1.5 mL tube.
Place tube in liquid nitrogen (100 mL cup) for 3 s.
Grind sputum with pestle for 60 s.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and Lysozyme
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of Proteinase K and 20 µL of Lysozyme (user‑supplied) to the precipitated slurry pellet, then vortex for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Add Slurry D and mix
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL of Slurry D for every 1 mL of sputum sample into a 15 mL conical tube, then mix well by inversion. (Note: Slurry D contains silicon carbide resin and must be mixed well before each pipetting.)

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 5 minutes at 2,000 RPM and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Incubate at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 60 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add Solution WN
steps.instruction: After the 20‑minute incubation, add 260 µL of Solution WN and mix well by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Transfer to spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire contents into a Mini Filter Spin column (provided) placed in its collection tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge to bind DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 minute at 14,000 RPM and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: First Wash with Solution BE
steps.instruction: Apply 500 µL of Wash Solution BE to the column, centrifuge for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through, and re‑assemble the spin column with its collection tube.

steps.title: Second Wash with Solution BE
steps.instruction: Repeat: apply 500 µL of Wash Solution BE, centrifuge 1 minute, discard flow‑through, and re‑assemble the column.

steps.title: Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Apply 500 µL of 96‑100 % ethanol (user‑supplied) to the column, centrifuge for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through, and re‑assemble the column with its collection tube.

steps.title: Dry resin
steps.instruction: Spin the column for 2 minutes to thoroughly dry the resin, then discard the collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a fresh 1.7 mL elution tube, add 100 µL of nuclease‑free water, centrifuge 2 minutes at 2,000 RPM, then centrifuge 1 minute at 14,000 RPM to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Quantify DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Determine DNA concentration using the DeNovix dsDNA Broad Range Fluorescent Assay Kit (DeNovix, Wilmington, USA).
